## TargetIntel-IO

::: {.project-card}
**Explainable therapeutic-intent-aware target triage for anti-PD-1-resistant melanoma**

TargetIntel-IO classifies genes by their translational role and ranks them differently depending on whether the intended use is an antibody or IO combination, a resistance biomarker, or a tumor-intrinsic small-molecule strategy.

[Read the project page](projects/targetintel-io.qmd) · [View the code](https://github.com/rsolerortuno/TargetIntel-IO)
:::
